# PaceBeacon

> Free pace calculators and reference charts for race planning.

## Core calculators

- [Race Pace Calculator](https://race-pace-calculator.com/): Calculate pace, distance, or finish time.
- [Marathon Pace Calculator](https://race-pace-calculator.com/marathon-pace-calculator): Calculate target pace and checkpoint splits.
- [Treadmill Pace Calculator](https://race-pace-calculator.com/treadmill-pace-calculator/): Convert treadmill speed to running pace.
- [Bike Pace Calculator](https://race-pace-calculator.com/bike-pace-calculator/): Calculate cycling speed, distance, or time.
- [Run-Walk Pace Calculator](https://race-pace-calculator.com/run-walk-pace-calculator/): Estimate average pace for run-walk intervals.
